blocks.prompt: What should a matrix trace check first?
choices: The state that proves the next move
The final button the user clicks
The color of the code editor
blocks.why: Check row and column together. Treating one dimension as the other causes many grid bugs.

blocks.prompt: Which debugging habit fits matrices best?
choices: Trace one small state change before trying a larger input
Start with the largest hidden case
Change the data structure after each failed test
Ignore the saved state and read only the final answer
blocks.why: Grid bugs are concrete. A two-by-two example shows whether row and column were swapped before the algorithm grows.

sections.title: Common matrix mistakes
sections.summary: Matrix code often uses the number of rows as the column limit. Rectangular grids expose that mistake quickly.
